source.capture_method: M3-T009 in-task capture 2026-10-14 (one direct HTTPS GET per channel, curl -A Mozilla/5.0; section node 18150 HTML + its print/PDF render)
source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 18150; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).

cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/18150, 302 -> print/pdf/node/18150) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext. Each block of the HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was confirmed to appear in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive; pdftotext intermittently inserts a space where the print breaks a hyphenated section number across a line, e.g. '24-\n52', which the comparison tolerates; the stored excerpt keeps the HTML's unbroken form). The print/PDF node renders this parent section AND its child sections; every block of this parent-body excerpt was confirmed present within that render, ending before the first child header; the children are out of scope for this capture. The PDF is regenerated per request (it carries a 'File generated ... on' banner), so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked.

verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label taken as the official print/PDF renders it; defined terms (bold-italic <strong><em> in the HTML) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF writes them, inner spacing preserved. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures (images) are omitted; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt. This is a parent section: the captured HTML page body is this parent's text only. Its print/PDF node renders the whole subtree (parent + child sections); the cross_check confirms every parent block is present and that the parent body ends before the first child-section header.
